text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: prometheus_scrape_failures_us-east-1 fired (threshold 5m). Autopage attempted.

maria (oncall): seeing the PD page. metrics dashboards for us-east look blank. can someone confirm?

kevin (sre): seeing scrape errors from 3 exporter clusters in us-east. Prometheus job 'node-exporter' 503s then timeouts.

incident-bot: Autopage suppression tried: 2 duplicate pages suppressed for the same fingerprint. PagerDuty escalation still active for first page.

maria (oncall): @kevin can you check the scrape-proxy logs? last deploy earlier today?

kevin (sre): checking now. `kubectl -n monitoring logs deploy/scrape-proxy -c proxy --since=5m`

kevin (sre): log snippet: ```time="2026-03-15T14:02:11Z" level=error msg="upstream connection reset" job=node-exporter target=10.12.3.45:9100```

kevin (sre): also seeing s3 write throttles on log-ingest but that might be unrelated.

emma (ops): FYI we had a transient network flap affecting the us-east overlay about 14:00 — cloud provider reported partial route churn. might line up.

maria (oncall): customer-ops, do we have any incoming tickets about missing metrics?

alice (customer-ops): one customer chat saying their dashboard is empty, they reported ~14:05. I asked for org id, they gave org-827. sending a short note: "we're investigating, may be regional".

john (sre-lead): quick triage plan: 1) confirm PD page owner and ack state 2) check scrape-proxy pods and restart if OOM/conn resets 3) verify kafka/log-ingest backlog 4) notify affected customers if degraded > 15m.

maria (oncall): PD shows page acknowledged by someone via mobile but there were duplicate PD pages looping — looks like PD retried while autopage suppression lagged. can we mute the autopage to avoid noise?

pagerbot: PagerDuty: page  P12345 -> acknowledged by kevin (sre). Duplicate pages P12346 suppressed.

kevin (sre): I'm on the pager. doing a rolling restart of scrape-proxy target group in us-east. command: ```kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart deployment/scrape-proxy --field-selector metadata.name=scrape-proxy -o name```

kevin (sre): restart kicked, pods coming up. watching metrics.

incident-bot: Detected increased prom scrape duration: 1200ms -> 8s for node-exporter job. Backoff applied by the sampler.

maria (oncall): while kevin restarts, can we increase scrape_timeout for that job to 30s as temporary? Risk: will increase scrape pressure but prevents flapping alerts.

kevin (sre): good call. patching Prometheus configmap and reloading: ```kubectl -n monitoring patch configmap/prometheus-config -p '{"data":{"prometheus.yml":"<patched with scrape_timeout: 30s for job node-exporter>"}}' && kubectl -n monitoring exec deploy/prometheus -- kill -HUP 1```

kevin (sre): changed and reloaded. note: we'll revert after stability.

emma (ops): cloud provider says route churn stabilized ~14:10. they recommend keeping nodes cordoned for checks if pods still failing.

maria (oncall): checking customer impact window: first alert 14:02, now 14:12. alice, please triage affected orgs and prepare a status broadcast if we hit 15m.

alice (customer-ops): on it. drafting small note: "We are investigating partial metrics missing for US-East. Engineers are applying mitigations. We'll update in 15 min or when resolved".

kevin (sre): scrape-proxy restarts look healthy. exporter job scrape rate recovering. prometheus targets up to 98% in us-east. log-ingest backlog still shows a small spike (10k msgs).

incident-bot: Autopage: 1 suppressed, 0 new pages in last 5m.

maria (oncall): good. leaving PD ack with kevin. john, do you want to take 2nd contact if this regresses?

john (sre-lead): I'll standby. if we see >=3% target drop or log backlog > 50k, escalate to infra and open a postmortem.

kevin (sre): final check: ran `kubectl -n monitoring get pods -l app=scrape-proxy` -> all Ready=1/1, older restarts count low. Prom dashboards show metrics returning.

maria (oncall): thanks all. I'll close the PD incident once kevin confirms stable for 5 more minutes. alice will send the customer note now.

alice (customer-ops): sent initial message to affected accounts. will follow up when cleared.

maria (oncall): marking this incident as mitigated for now — keep thread open for 30m for monitoring. add action: review autopage suppression timing to avoid duplicate PD pages next time. :white_check_mark:

kevin (sre): agreed. will collect logs and file a short blameless writeup with timeline.

incident-bot: Incidentbot: thread closed for alerts but channel thread remains open.

maria (oncall): last check 14:20, metrics stable. closing this thread at 14:19 UTC.
